servers.name: mapbox
servers.description: Official Mapbox MCP server for global geocoding, search, routing, isochrones, static maps, and offline geospatial analysis.

tools.name: search_and_geocode_tool
tools.description: Search places globally and resolve them to coordinates.

tools.name: directions_tool
tools.description: Get multimodal routes with optional traffic-aware driving.

tools.name: matrix_tool
tools.description: Compute travel-time or distance matrices across many origins and destinations.

tools.name: isochrone_tool
tools.description: Build time- or distance-based reachability polygons.

tools.name: static_map_image_tool
tools.description: Render static map images for reports or reviews.

servers.name: baidu-maps
servers.description: Official Baidu Maps MCP server for Chinese geocoding, POI search, routing, weather, IP location, and traffic.

tools.name: map_reverse_geocode
tools.description: Resolve coordinates into addresses and nearby context.

tools.name: map_search_places
tools.description: Search POIs by keyword, type, region, or radius.

tools.name: map_directions
tools.description: Plan driving, walking, cycling, or transit routes.

tools.name: map_weather
tools.description: Query local weather by region or coordinates.
